about: Built by python -m system.rag.library from corpus/sources.yaml. Do not edit by hand.
scope: England only: search returns rules that apply in England (UK-wide and GB-wide documents included). Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland have their own rules, not covered.
English text only (ADR 0012, S130): translations and Romanian leaflets are not in the library.
Versions in force on or after 1 January 2025 (ADR 0016). Older editions are not held.
Text only: drawings, diagrams and photos are not read, only their captions and the text around them.
Only documents we may copy (Open Government Licence). Paid standards and contracts are listed as gaps.
known_weak_parts: Tables in Approved Documents and guidance PDFs: a check on 23 Nov 2026 found a serious reading problem on about 1 in 8 of the pages it sampled, mostly tables. Fixes are in progress; quote tables with care.
Each search returns the best few passages only. A broad question can miss the rule it needs: split it into short searches, one per topic.
quality: How often search finds the right passage is not measured yet (S151). Until then, answer only from the passages returned and cite them.

types.hse_guidance: HSE guidance and approved codes of practice

reasons.paid_standard: Paid or copyrighted standard: we may not copy it, so we hold only the link.
reasons.paid_contract: Paid standard contract: we may not copy it, so we hold only the link.
reasons.licence_unclear: Licence unclear or not checked yet: not copied until it is.
reasons.link_only: Link only: the publisher's terms bar copying, or the text could not be fetched.
reasons.not_english: Not in English: the library holds English text only.
reasons.withdrawn: Withdrawn or out of date: listed so we know it has gone.
